title: Copy one side of an ID card on a flatbed copier
instruction: Pick up the ID card, place it face-down on the scanner glass, close the lid, and press Scan. Wait for the copier to print.
context: Front desks at clinics, hotels and banks photocopy an identity card for the file. One side is the usual case: the card goes face-down on the glass, the lid is closed, Scan is pressed, and the sheet comes out of the front.
setup: On the station bench, one fixed rigid-plastic all-in-one. Its housing is 320 mm along the feed and 420 mm across, with the platen glass 125 mm above the bench, 220 mm deep by 300 mm wide. The white lid (245 x 330 x 14 mm) is hinged on the back edge of the glass and starts 1.55 rad from shut, held by hinge friction. A green Scan key (18 x 16 x 10 mm) sits on the front-right of the deck and a black latch (16 x 40 x 14 mm) in the front centre. A lamp bar travels 280 mm under the glass. Behind the platen, a paper support rises 200 mm and leans back 25 degrees from vertical around an 8 mm slit. A grey exit tray, 240 x 178 x 6 mm, stands on a pillar in front of the mouth with its top 200 mm above the bench. A fixed dark plastic stand, 55 x 27 x 23 mm, is at 150 mm forward and 320 mm to the left of the bench origin. The ID card (85.60 x 53.98 x 0.76 mm, 5 g, rigid, friction 1.0) starts blue-side up on that stand. One A4 sheet (297 x 210 x 0.10 mm, 5 g, rigid white paper) starts in the slit, leaning back 25 degrees, printable face toward the robot. Two graphic marks (the blue face and the red face) start inside the housing and are not grasped.
scoring: From poses once motion has settled, held for 1 second. A scan counts only when the lid stays shut (at most 0.12 rad and the detent has held for 0.30 s), one face of the card is flat on the glass (tilt at most 12 degrees, centre within 6 mm of the seat height, within 16 mm of the platen centre in depth and 95 mm across), Scan is pressed, and the lamp then travels the full 280 mm. Opening the lid during that pass voids it. 0.25 once that scan exists. 0.5 once the matching mark is on the sheet's up face, within 8 mm of the place that matches where the card lay (across the glass maps along the page). 1.0 when, in addition, the sheet's trailing edge is at least 20 mm outside the front mouth, the sheet is face up and tilted at most 12 degrees, slower than 2 cm/s, and both grippers are at least 5 cm from the sheet and the card. Any other state scores 0.
reset_notes: The graphic marks are put back inside the housing on reset. Use a blank sheet for a real trial.
fidelity: The card and sheet are rigid, with full-size outlines and thin collision. Paper bending and roller contact are not modelled: after a scan, with the sheet in the slit and both grippers 40 mm clear, the copier carries it through, sticks the graphic on the up face, and sets it on the tray. The lid is a passive hinge with friction and damping and no spring. The hand-off near 78 degrees is set by that friction, not measured on a real scanner.
scores: Dream-1: refused before acting; scripted demo: 1.0
